critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: on /orders?order=<id> the drawer auto-opens AND the order-fill button is also rendered; because the drawer overlay intercepts pointer events, the order-fill button cannot be clicked until the drawer is closed. Not a bug (the form is already visible inside the drawer) but testing agents / users clicking the yellow card button while drawer is open will see a dead click. Consider dismissing the deep-link search param after first open, or hiding the order-fill button when its drawer is already open.

Minor consistency: StatusBadge in the drawer header shows '等待中' for status=paid even when info_submitted=false, while orderLabel() on the card shows '待填寫資料'. If you want parity, make StatusBadge also honour the info_submitted=false case. Current behaviour matches the spec but can be slightly confusing.
server.py pay_order_wallet should probably return 402 (not 404/400) when insufficient balance — _wallet_tx already raises 402, which is correct and the UI handles it correctly, confirmed.
